newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Coffee could push higher but stay in range.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Coffee could push higher but stay in range.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Robusta coffee futures look well supported and should gradually push their way higher towards the upper end of the current trading range, technical analysts said on Friday.

Traders said a realistic expectation would be for London to open around $40 higher than Thursday's close. London ended Thursday's session with pared gains after tracking early losses on nearby arabicas.
Technical analysts said the improving fortunes of the New York market could boost sentiment in London, where benchmark September has already bounced this week from a reaction low of $1,477.
"New York is starting to look a bit better so it should drag London higher," said Adrian Haylor, a technical analyst at Sucden.
"But for the time being one has to say it (London) is caught in a range between $1,550 and $1,650," he said.
Nearby resistance was pegged at $1,645, the peak of the lower trading range which September gapped into in the middle of last month.
"We'll be looking for a test of resistance in the coming sessions...and it's found a pretty good area of support," Haylor said.
But September would also face heavy resistance at around $1,700, coupled with other technical hurdles such as a cluster of short-term moving averages arranged from around $1,610 up to $1,810.
Traders also said the recent bounce confirmed that the market had hit its bottom for the time being, although they remained wary of any substantial change in sentiment.
"We have seen a bottom. But until we get above $1,700, we can't talk of a bullish move yet," said one. --Jeremy Smith, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8064
